subject: laply (or similar) based on another condition

messages.author: 9ff02ee016b8a9e0
messages.subject: laply (or similar) based on another condition
parts:
Hello manipulatr folks,

I need to replicate names from a data frame based on the corresponding
number (in the same row) in a separate column in the same data frame,
and output all the names in a vector. Which tool do I use?

Here is a simple example:

mydata <- data.frame(myletters = c("a","b","c","d","e"), myreps =
c(1,2,3,4,5))

To be specific, I want "a" replicated 1 time, "b" replicated 2 times,
etc.


Thanks, Scott

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: laply (or similar) based on another condition
parts:
Hi Scott,

You only need rep ;)

with(mydata, rep(myletters, myreps))

Hadley
